To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Operation Magpie was an innovative project which involved the community in a citizen science project to collect data about magpies, and that it was an inspiring professional learning opportunity for teachers.
the teachers’ engagement in a collaborative professional learning community was a significant factor in their success in implementing an environmental education unit.

teachers need professional learning support to teach units of work that involve students in citizen science, that teachers need to be supported in their planning of the units of work and that teachers can find ways to teach science in ways that are relevant to their students.
In summary, our research is concerned with

how teacher educators, in partnership with teachers and environmental scientists, can support teachers to engage in professional learning through the planning of a science unit that connects with their local environment.
the ways teachers can be supported to teach environmental science and how teachers' pedagogy is influenced by their own learning experiences.
the development of teachers' professional learning through environmental science.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Operation Magpie was an innovative and successful way to support teachers to engage students in science and environmental education.

Operation Magpie was an inspiring professional learning experience for teachers, and the project provided an opportunity for teachers to engage with the science curriculum in a meaningful and authentic way.
Operation Magpie is a successful model for professional learning that is based on teachers' needs and interests, and which provides teachers with a supportive community of practice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
teachers need ongoing professional learning that is focused, collaborative and needs-based.
the project provided a model of teacher professional development that was successful because of the collaborative approach between the teacher educators, scientists and the teachers themselves.
Operation Magpie provided a platform for teachers to engage with the environment and their students through an authentic citizen science project.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the project inspired teachers to develop their professional knowledge in science teaching, and to develop a greater understanding of the role of science in the community.
teachers can be inspired and supported to engage their students in citizen science projects.
teachers can be supported to plan and teach science in innovative ways, and that this can be done in partnership with environmental scientists.
